description: Polyphonic Bernoulli gate: every channel of the gate input is sent at random to one of two outputs, with the odds set by CHANCE

params.text: Sets the odds for every channel alike, from all gates going to OUT A at one end of the travel to all going to OUT B at the other, and an even split in the middle
LATCH holds the chosen output high until a toss comes out differently; the centre position passes the input gate to the chosen output; TOGGLE changes output only when a toss differs from the last

inputs.text: Each channel patched here is tossed on its own rising edge, and the number of channels here sets the number of channels on both outputs
Shifts the odds towards OUT B, added to the CHANCE setting; a monophonic cable moves every channel alike, while each channel of a polyphonic cable moves only its own channel

outputs.text: Carries a 10V gate on each channel whose toss falls its way; with CHANCE fully anticlockwise every gate comes out here
Carries a 10V gate on each channel whose toss falls its way; with CHANCE fully clockwise every gate comes out here

notes: the grid of lamps shows, channel by channel, which of the two outputs the last toss chose
